tickets.title: Update cash‑flow model for Maplesprocket family
tickets.text: Update the cash‑flow model for Corin and Malia Maplesprocket to reflect their three‑person household, incorporating the $2,250 monthly infant care tuition, partially unpaid parental leave, and upcoming payroll benefit changes to produce a revised short‑term cash reserve and monthly surplus estimate.
tickets.evidence: the agreed cash-flow model follow-up is dated 2024-02-23.

tickets.title: Review equity award position and planning choices
tickets.text: Evaluate Corin Maplesprocket's current equity award inventory, plan rules, tax exposure, liquidity needs, and concentration risk. Collect the relevant plan documents and prepare planning notes that can support advisor recommendations and coordination with the client's tax professional. Reconcile the discrepancy between Corin's personal spreadsheet and the Teacup Comet Robotics stock‑plan portal, confirming the 1,850 unvested RSUs and 420 vested shares.

subTasks.title: Collect award and plan documents
subTasks.text: Request the current equity award statement, grant agreements, vesting schedule, stock plan portal summary, exercise history, and any employer trading-window or blackout guidance.

subTasks.title: Summarize tax and liquidity considerations
subTasks.text: Identify award types, vested versus unvested shares, exercise costs, estimated withholding, potential AMT exposure if applicable, sale restrictions, and expected cash needs tied to the decision.

subTasks.title: Prepare concentration and diversification notes
subTasks.text: Compare company stock exposure with the client's broader portfolio, identify single-stock concentration concerns, and outline staged sale or hedging discussion points where appropriate.

subTasks.title: Coordinate review questions for outside tax professional
subTasks.text: Draft questions for the client's CPA or tax professional regarding withholding, estimated payments, AMT, state tax issues, and timing considerations before the client acts.

tickets.evidence: the agreed equity award record reconciliation follow-up is dated 2024-02-29.

tickets.title: Review life and disability insurance needs
tickets.text: Review the life and disability insurance coverage for Corin and Malia Maplesprocket, comparing existing group and supplemental policies against the family’s survivor income, mortgage payoff, childcare, and education funding targets after the birth of Isla, and identify any gaps or adjustments needed.
tickets.evidence: the agreed life and disability insurance needs review follow-up is dated 2024-03-01.

tickets.title: Coordinate estate attorney planning memo
tickets.text: Prepare a planning memorandum for estate attorney Priya Lanternmoss outlining guardian nominees, backup trustee choices, beneficiary alignment, and an assessment of whether the existing 2019 wills and powers of attorney still meet the Maplesprocket household’s needs after the addition of Isla.
